valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 26 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a takaful (Islamic) insurance group, mostly general insurance: Sri Lanka general takaful (company, GWP Rs 5.76bn in 2025), 55% of Amana Takaful (Maldives) PLC (general, GWP Rs 5.43bn, most of the profit), 76.3% of Amana Takaful Life PLC (family takaful, GWP Rs 1.76bn) and 79% of Amana Sugurta (Uzbekistan, starting up) (Annual Report 2025, PDF pp. 94, 139). One sector: insurance. (2)–(3) An insurer, so the sector's levered beta is used without relevering. Damodaran's emerging-markets file (betaEmerg) couldn't be opened from this run (pages.stern.nyu.edu blocked). The only stand-ins already on this site are his January 2026 global Insurance (General) unlevered beta 0.42 (cash-corrected 0.47, as used for INME.N0000), which is unlevered and has no levered pair here, and his global Insurance (Life) levered beta 0.80 (as used for JINS.N0000). The higher, 0.80, is used for prudence. (4) Local 5-year betas: none could be checked from this run (the CSE site is blocked here; web results gave no 5-year beta). (5) 0.80. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7)–(8) Put into scripts/reinvestment.py and shown in the Required return tile. Refresh in January 2027 with the emerging-markets Insurance (Prop/Cas.) levered beta and three local 5-year betas.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (26 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 0.80 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 16.5%, ±1.5 points. No WACC: an insurer is valued on equity.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 4% / 5% / 6% long-run growth; supported 8.3% (share of profit kept × ROE, FY 2025: 94.9% × 8.8%). All within 2 pts.
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py on FY 2025. The company itself paid no dividend in 2024, 2025 or 2026 to date; the Rs 18.2mn of dividends in the 2025 cash flow went to the subsidiaries' minority shareholders, so the share kept is really about 100%. Growth is paid for by profit kept in every method (payout 1 − g ÷ ROE in P/E; book grows by retained profit in residual income).

valuationInputs.name: 2027 EPS (normal profit)
valuationInputs.value: Rs 0.70 / 1.35 / 2.15 (owners' profit about Rs 0.21bn / 0.40bn / 0.64bn on 299.5mn shares)
valuationInputs.reason: Owners' profit Rs 480mn (2024), Rs 360mn (2025, with Cyclone Ditwah claims in Q4) and Rs 227mn in nine months of 2026 (Rs 546mn a year earlier); the third quarter of 2026 lost Rs 189mn. Most profit comes from the 55% Maldives subsidiary (parent share Rs 581mn in 2024, Rs 513mn in 2025; Maldives PBT Rs 740mn in nine months of 2026 against Rs 1,038mn), while the Sri Lanka general business lost money on its own (company PBT less share of subsidiaries: −Rs 61mn 2024, −Rs 117mn 2025, −Rs 165mn in 9M 2026). Base: Maldives share about Rs 0.45–0.5bn and Sri Lanka near break-even less some losses; bear: Maldives at 9M-2026 pace and Sri Lanka losses continue; bull: Sri Lanka turns profitable and Maldives recovers to 2024 levels. The run-rate (Rs 0.14 twelve months, negative last quarter × 4) is far below all three because it includes the cyclone quarter and the Q3 2026 loss.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Owners' ROE on average equity: 13.0% (2024: Rs 480mn on Rs 3.31–4.10bn), 7.9% (2025: Rs 360mn on Rs 4.10–4.98bn; company's own figure 7.24%), about 1% in the twelve months to Sep 2026. EPS was negative in 2023 (−Rs 0.06) and 2019–2020. Bull = the 2024 level; base below it because the May 2026 rights issue added Rs 1.0bn of equity before profit has grown.

valuationInputs.name: Long-term growth
valuationInputs.reason: Same in every method; below the 12.24% bond yield and the cost of equity.

valuationInputs.name: Residual income start
valuationInputs.value: ROE 6.2% (base 2027 EPS Rs 1.35 ÷ NAV Rs 21.89); payout 0%
valuationInputs.reason: NAV per share Rs 21.89 at 30 Sep 2026 (note 22). No dividend has been paid by the company in 2024–2026, so all profit is kept; ROE moves in a straight line to the long-run ROE over ten years.

valuationInputs.name: Dividends
valuationInputs.reason: Dividend per share '-' for 2024 and 2025 (Annual Report 2025, PDF p. 161) and none in 2026 to September. With no dividend to grow, the dividend model isn't meaningful.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Justified price to book, P/E (justified at the cost of equity), residual income
valuationInputs.reason: An insurer: no cash-flow DCF and no WACC (CLAUDE.md). No dividend, so no dividend model. No embedded value is published. All three worked by scripts/valuation.py.

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add ATL.N0000). First analysis from the three CSE downloads: Annual Report 2025 and the interims to 30 June and 30 September 2026 (the March 2026 interim wasn't downloaded; Q1 figures not recorded). Record holds printed figures only, FY 2021–2023 from the ten-year summary. Beta 0.80 provisional (Damodaran's site and the CSE site blocked from this run). Methods: justified P/B, justified P/E and residual income by scripts/valuation.py at a 16.5% cost of equity; no dividend model (no dividend paid). Business tests 1 of 4 (only capital/borrowing passes, with the CAR not disclosed): category 3, avoid for now. Price is the 30 Sep 2026 close from the interim (Rs 22.30), as the CSE close couldn't be fetched; the site build replaces it with the daily close.
